scope: Trainer inventory section navigation and rows
shared inventory section navigation and rows
Use, Equip, Give, Transfer, Split, Merge, Discard, and Inspect controls
equipment, recovery, exploration, Extended Action, and activity controls

responsive.desktop: preserve the native semantic table and the inventory/activity hierarchy
responsive.narrowRows: reflow each semantic table row into one labelled matte card without changing source order or table header associations
responsive.decisionFlow: the selected inventory row precedes its full-width decision and accepted activity remains secondary
responsive.zoom: content reflows at a 320 CSS-pixel viewport, equivalent to 400 percent zoom on a 1280-pixel layout, without two-dimensional scrolling

keyboard.sheetNavigation: one roving tab stop with Arrow keys, Home, and End activation
keyboard.sectionTabs: ARIA tablist and tabpanel with one roving tab stop; Arrow keys, Home, and End both focus and activate
keyboard.sourceChoices: ARIA radiogroup with one roving tab stop; Arrow keys, Home, and End select and focus
keyboard.inlineEditing: Enter or Space opens an editor; Enter commits and Escape cancels; both return focus to the same field trigger while blur preserves forward tab order
keyboard.decisionOpen: focus moves to the decision heading
keyboard.decisionClose: focus returns to the originating row action when it remains, otherwise to the active inventory section tab
keyboard.focusIndicator: electric cyan plus a visible two-pixel or stronger outline

coveredTargets: save, reload, recovery, equipment, exploration, and history actions

screenReader.table: native table, column-header, and row-header semantics remain present at every breakpoint
screenReader.mobileLabels: the same Name, quantity, source, cost, description, and Actions labels are visible in reflow
screenReader.selectedSource: Selected source text accompanies the cyan signal and aria-current state
screenReader.editors: each editable trigger and active input names its field and current safe item label
screenReader.unavailableActions: disabled action names include a concise safe textual reason rather than depending on title or colour alone
screenReader.rowChanges: adding or removing an editable row is announced through a polite live region
screenReader.status: pending, accepted, conflict, error, reservation, and recovery states retain their existing status or alert regions

destructive: Discard label and trash or warning icon
danger colour reserved for the destructive consequence
sensoryIndependence.quantitySourceTargetCost: safe textual labels remain visible and are never communicated by colour or icon alone

motion.reducedMotion: inventory and sheet navigation and inline edit triggers remove decorative transitions when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce

forbiddenVisibleFields: stable inventory row or source-instance ID
raw command, ownership evidence, or private note
